note: Probe mode (register decisions 187-204). Judged four ways: view/Half.hpp by its static_asserts and test_half; the dump by test_hdr_dump, whose writer-and-reader case ties the two implementations to one statement of the format; the PNG, EXR and sidecar encoders by test_image_files and test_probe_sidecar; and the GPU path -- shader, probe setup, offscreen rendering, command line -- by the probe's own CTest tests, which render the frame with the mutant and read it back. **Run 2026-09-26: 20 caught, 1 survived, 0 invalid, 0 hung** -- 3 by a static_assert before a test ran. Every kill was read, not counted: each fell to the judge it was aimed at, the GPU ones to test_probe_clear's band check, --probe-out to probe_clear_determinism, and the HDR target without TRANSFER_SRC to probe_clear's validation layers. The survivor -- the barrier that makes the copies visible to the host -- is a real gap this machine cannot show, declared and put to the owner. The first run stopped at the eighth mutant: mutate.py decoded a suite's output in the Windows code page, and one byte outside it crashed the reader; fixed to decode UTF-8 with replacement, and the whole pass re-run. **Run a third time the same day, on commit 26e207c**, after gcc-14 and MSVC had changed the code under several mutants (the conversion split into a bit pattern, decision 205): the same 20 caught and 1 survived, and the NaN mutant re-anchored to the bit-pattern function. **Inherited survivors re-run the same day** with the probe's tests as judges: M1-13's LESS depth comparison and M1-14's quarter-size triangle are caught and their declarations removed; the six that act after the HDR target (M1-14's resolve never drawn and 2.2 encode, M1-15's three shader operations) and M1-14's scene pipelines in the swapchain's format still survive, re-pointed at M1-17, M1-18 and M1-19.

mutants.why: Without the barrier the host may read the readback buffers before the transfer's writes are visible to it. On this machine it cannot be seen: the fence wait and host-coherent memory make the values arrive anyway, and the validation layers do not check host access. A real gap, not an equivalent mutant; found by this pass on 2026-09-26 and put to the owner with the task's report.
